specs.title: ai room: one team reaches the pass score and sees the clue, another does not

steps.title: the AI manager imports the JSON file and sets the pass score

the other 39 questions are answered and Finish MCQs (confirmed) opens the repairs
repair 1 is put in order with the ▲/▼ buttons
a reload opens repair 2 and keeps repair 1 locked
repair 2 is ordered by drag and drop
the last repair (as shown, partial credit) records the result: Clue unlocked
Team 02 submits its repairs without answering: the required score is not reached
the manager's results show the pass score, each team's status and clue

specs.title: terminal: the Linux team boots Linux in the browser, greps the room's file and submits the line

steps.title: the Linux manager adds logs/lock.log on the room board
on a phone the form stays as it is, with a note and a way to open the terminal
the AI team never gets the terminal and gets 404 for the Linux files
Start terminal boots Linux with the room's file in ~/logs
grep finds the OVERRIDE line
the selected line becomes the technical output and the team submits as usual
at Time's up the terminal says Time is up and takes no more input

specs.title: event: rounds, room clues, judging, recovery, accusation, ranking and publication

steps.title: AI manager sets the room's clue key on the board
the other managers set their keys
admin moves to round 1 (assigned) and opens the AI room
team is sent to the AI room; the form waits for the timer
AI manager confirms all teams are here
admin starts the timer although 3 rooms are not ready
team submits a wrong, then the correct AI clue
admin pauses; the team sees the round is paused
admin adds a minute and resumes
AI manager passes the team and adds a hint penalty
admin ends the round; the team sees time is up
helper plays rounds 2-3 and finishes the rooms
team home shows three collected clues
admin opens the final
team recovers the missing Hardware clue
team accuses wrongly, then solves the case
admin sees Team 01 first and publishes
team opens the published ranking
